characteristics.$text: Disruption Emitters apply a negative modifier to certain characteristics of nearby models.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Disruption Emitter Marker must be set up by the Player that selected it at the start of the Deploy Armies Step. It must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere on the Battlefield that is not within their Opponent's deployment zone.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: While any Models from a Unit are within 6" of the centre of a Disruption Emitter Marker, modify the Leadership, Cool, Intelligence, and Willpower Characteristics of all Models in that Unit by -1.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: At the end of each Battle Turn, the player that selected it rolls one Dice for each Disruption Emitter Marker they set up. On a 1, that Disruption Emitter Marker is removed from the Battlefield.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Attaccante
characteristics.name: Tratti

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: A Unit near a Forward Ammunition Drop may gain a benefit when making certain Shooting Attacks.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Forward Ammunition Drop Marker is set up by the Player that selected it at the start of the Deploy Armies Step. It must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere on the Battlefield more than 6" away from that Player's Deployment Zone.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: When a Unit that has Models within 3" of the centre of a Forward Ammunition Drop Marker is selected to make a Shooting Attack, the Controlling Player of that Unit can declare they will activate that Marker. Only one Forward Ammunition Drop Marker can be utilised per Shooting Attack. When they do, that Player can nominate one Weapon which Models in that Unit have that has a Base Ranged Strength of 5 or less, and does not have the Heavy (X), Ordnance (X), Blast (X), or Template Special Rules. Until that Shooting Attack is resolved, the Firepower Characteristic of each nominated Weapon in that unit is increased by +1.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: After that Shooting Attack has been resolved, the Controlling Player of the Unit making the Shooting Attack rolls one Dice. On a 4+, the Forward Ammunition Drop Marker is removed from the Battlefield.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Esplosivo
characteristics.name: Tratti

characteristics.$text: Models close to a Graviton Snare risk becoming Pinned.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Graviton Snare Marker must be set up by the Player that selected it at the end of the Prepare the Battlefield Step of the Mission Sequence.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: If a Unit is selected to move in the Movement Phase or make a Charge Move while any Models from that Unit are within 6" of the centre of a Graviton Snare Marker, the Controlling Player of that Unit must roll one Dice for each Model from that Unit that is within 6" of the centre of that Graviton Snare Marker. On a 1, that Model triggers the snare and the Unit that includes that Model gains the Pinned Tactical Status, and that Graviton Snare Marker is removed from the Battlefield.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: Removed when triggered (see above).
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Difensore, Campo Minato
characteristics.name: Tratti

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: A Strategic Cogitator Array allows a Player to increase the value of a Secondary Objective.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Strategic Cogitator Array is set up by the Player that selected it at the start of the Deploy Armies Step. It must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere within that Player's Deployment Zone.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: If the Active Player has a Model with the Command Sub-Type within 3" of the centre of a Strategic Cogitator Array Marker at the end of their Movement Phase, they can request new orders. If they do so, that Player rolls one Dice. If the result is higher than the current Battle Turn number, the request is successful and that Player may select one Secondary Objective in use in that Battle and increate the value of X on that Secondary Objective by 1, and then the Strategic Cogitator Array Marker is removed from the Battlefield. Each Model with the Command Sub-Type can only request new orders once per Turn, and each Secondary Objective can only have its value increased once in this manner
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: Removed when used successfully (see above).
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra
Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: Melta Mines may be triggered by larger war machines.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Melta Minefield Marker must be set up by the Player that selected it at the end of the Prepare the Battlefield Step of the Mission Sequence.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: If a Unit that contains any Models with the Walker or Vehicle Types ends a move within 6" of the centre of a Melta Minefield Marker, the Controlling Player of that Unit must roll a number of Dice for each Model from that Unit that is within 6" of the centre of that Melta Minefield Marker. The number of Dice rolled for each Model is equal to the Base Wounds or Hull Points Characteristic of that Model. For each mine that is triggered, the Unit suffers a Hit, resolved against the weakest Armour Facing (if the unit has Armour Values) with a Strength of 9, an AP of 2, and a Damage of 2.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: Once these its have been resolved, the Controlling Player of the Unit whose move triggered a mine rolls a Dice. On a 4+, that Melta Minefield Marker is removed from the Battlefield.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Difensore, Campo Minato
characteristics.name: Tratti

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: Each Frag Minefield Marker must be set up by the Player that selected it at the end of the Prepare the Battlefield Step of the Mission Sequence.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: If a Unit ends a move with one or more Models within 6" of the centre of a Frag Minefield Marker, the Controlling Player of that Unit must roll one Dice for each Model from such a Unit that is within 6" of the centre of that Frag Minefield Marker. On a 1, that Model triggers a mine. Centre a 3" Blast Marker on that Model. Every Unit that has any Models under one of these Blast Markers suffers 1 Hit for each Model from that Unit that is under each Blast Marker. Each such Hit has a Strength of 5, an AP of 5, and a Damage of 1.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: Once these its have been resolved, the Controlling Player of the Moving Unit rolls a Dice. On a 4+, that Frag Minefield Marker is removed from the Battlefield.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Difensore, Campo Minato
characteristics.name: Tratti

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: A Contingency Device may be detonated when a nearby Unit falls back.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Contingency Device Marker is set up by the Player that selected it at the start of the Deploy Armies Step. It must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere within that Payer's Deployment Zone.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: If the Player who set up a Contingency Device Marker would make a Panic Check during the Fight Sub-Phase for a Unit with at least one Model within 3" of the centre of a Contingency Device Marker in their Deployment Zone, they can attempt to trigger the device. If they do so, that Player makes an Intelligence Check for that Unit. If the Check is successful, the device is triggered. When the device is triggered, every unit with at least one Model within 6" of the centre of that Contingency Device Marker suffers a number of Hits equal to the number of Models from that Unit that are within 6" of the centre of that Marker. Each such Hit has a Strength of 7, an AP of4, a Damage of 2, and the Breaching (5+) and Shred (6+) Special Rules.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: Once these Hits have been resolved, that Contingency Device Marker is removed from the Battlefield and the Panic Check is made for the Unit as normal.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Difensore, Esplosivo
characteristics.name: Tratti

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: Tank Traps block the Movement of Vehicles.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Tank Traps Marker must be a maximum of 60mm wide and be set up by the Player that selected it at the start of the Deploy Armies Step. It must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere on the Battlefield that is not within their Opponent's Deployment Zone.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: A Tank Traps Marker is treated as Impassable terrain for Vehicle Models (this is an exception to the Battlefield Asset Markers Rules).
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: Each Tank Traps Marker can be selected as the Target of Charges and of Ranged and Melee Attacks, and is treated as a Model with the Vehicle Type with a single Facing with an Armour Value of 14 and a Hull Points Characteristic of 2. A Each Tank Traps Marker cannot gain any Tactical Statuses.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Difensore
characteristics.name: Tratti

characteristics.$text: When triggered, Shroud Canisters can provide the Shrouded (X) Special Rule to Models nearby.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Shroud Canister Marker must be set up by the Player that selected it at the end of the Prepare the Battlefield Step of the Mission Sequence.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text:
In the Effects Sub-Phase of the End Phase of their Player Turn, the Player who set up each Shroud Canister can select to trigger it. If they do, until the Shroud Canister Marker is removed:
- Models within 3" of the centre of a triggered Shroud Canister Marker have the Shrouded (4+) Special Rule.
- Models within 6" of the centre of a triggered Shroud Canister Marker have the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule.
- Models within 9" of the centre of a triggered Shroud Canister Marker have the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: In the Effects Sub-Phase of the End Phase of the next Player Turn, a triggered Shroud Canister is removed from the Battlefield.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Attaccante
characteristics.name: Tratti

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: When triggered, Vehicle and Walker Models near a Neutron Bomb may gain the Suppressed Tactical Status.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Neutron Bomb Marker must be set up by the Player that selected it at the end of the Prepare the Battlefield Step of the Mission Sequence.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: If a Unit is selected to move in the Movement Phase or make a Charge Move while any Models from that Unit with the Vehicle or Walker Type are within 6" of the centre of a Neutron Bomb Marker, the Controlling Player of that Unit must roll one Dice for each Model from that Unit which is within 6" of the centre of a Neutron Bomb Marker. On a 4+, that Model triggers the Neutron Bomb and the Unit that includes that Model gains the Suppressed Tactical Status, and that Neutron Bomb Marker is removed from the Battlefield.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: Removed when triggered (see above).
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Difensore, Campo Minato
characteristics.name: Tratti

characteristics.$text: Auto-Repair Servitor Clades can assist in removing Tactical Statuses from friendly Vehicle Models.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Auto-Repair Servitor Clade Marker is set up by the Player that selected it at the start of the Deploy Armies Step. It must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere within that Player's Deployment Zone.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: At the start of the Defender's Statuses Sub-Phase, that Player can select one Model with the Vehicle Type that is within 4" of the centre of the Auto-Repair Servitor Clade Marker they set up. Until the end of that Sub-Phase, that Vehicle has the Auto-Repair (4+) Special Rule.
characteristics.name: Effetto

characteristics.$text: If a Blast Marker covers the centre of an Auto-Repair Servitor Clade Marker, then after that Shooting Attack has been resolved, the Controlling Player of the Unit making the Shooting Attack must roll one Dice. On a 4+, that Auto-Repair Servitor Clade Marker is removed.
characteristics.name: Come Distruggere

characteristics.$text: Difensore
characteristics.name: Tratti

costs.name: Punti Combinati di Generale e Sovrano della Guerra

characteristics.$text: A Wayfinder Device can grant nearby Models the Move Through Cover Special Rule.
characteristics.name: Riepilogo

characteristics.$text: Each Wayfinder Device Marker must be set up by the Player that selected it at the start of the Deploy Armies Step. It must be set up with the centre of the Marker anywhere on the Battlefield that is not within their Opponent's Deployment Zone.
characteristics.name: Preparazione

characteristics.$text: In the Effects Sub-Phase of their Player Turn, the Player who set up a Wayfinder Device can select to trigger it. If they do, they can select one Area of Difficult or Dangerous Terrain that is wholly within 12" of the centre of that Wayfinder Device Marker. Models from that Player's Army are treated as having the Move Through Cover Special Rule while moving through the selected Area Terrain during that Turn.
characteristics.name: Effetto

sharedRules.description: Un Assetto del Campo di Battaglia con il Tratto Campo Minato deve essere posizionato con il centro del Segnalino in qualsiasi punto del Campo di Battaglia che si trovi a più di 6" dal centro di qualsiasi altro Segnalino Assetto del Campo di Battaglia con il Tratto Assetto Campo Minato, e non all'interno della Zona di Schieramento di un avversario.
sharedRules.name: Tratto Assetto Campo Minato

sharedRules.description: Se un Segnalino Area copre il centro di un Segnalino Assetto del Campo di Battaglia con il Tratto Assetto Esplosivo, allora dopo che quell'Attacco a Distanza è stato risolto, il Giocatore Controllante dell'Unità che effettua l'Attacco a Distanza deve tirare un Dado. Con un 4+, ogni Unità entro 6" dal centro di quel Segnalino Assetto del Campo di Battaglia subisce un numero di Colpi pari al costo in Punti Assetto di quel Segnalino. Ognuno di questi Colpi ha Forza 8, un VP di '-', un Danno di 1 e le Regole Speciali Perforante (5+) e Lacerante (5+).
sharedRules.name: Tratto Assetto Esplosivo

sharedRules.description: Gli Assetti del Campo di Battaglia con il Tratto Attaccante possono essere selezionati solo dal Giocatore che assume quel ruolo nella Missione giocata.
sharedRules.name: Tratto Assetto Attaccante

sharedRules.description: Gli Assetti del Campo di Battaglia con il Tratto Difensore possono essere selezionati solo dal Giocatore che assume quel ruolo nella Missione giocata.
